description: Surface-type catalog used after a ground trace: selects footstep/ground-contact/dash/jump/landing/down/bound effects and sounds, plus Niagara ground attributes and effect color per physical surface.

ID.simple: Physical-surface row key (exported as ID for native FName Id / ImportKeyField).
ID.technical: FName row key (native Id, export key ID, ImportKeyField="Id") matched against the UPhysicsSettings PhysicalSurfaces name from a line trace through CN_050_GroundObjectTypes. AGameCharacter/AGameTrap trace Location +/- Distance on Z (GetMapGroundRowAtLocation and AGameShikigami use Distance=50; other call sites pass 100/200/500); a miss or SurfaceType_Default yields NAME_None and no row. First matching table in MapGroundDataTables (+0x3D0) wins. Sequencer ground-effect/SE evaluates instead call AGameSequencerManager::FindMapGroundRow with Section.GroundTraceLength (section defaults 10 for effect+SE and 120 for SE-only) and an offset (ankle height or zero); the EffectColor evaluate uses a separate fixed 100-unit downward trace. Id itself is also consumed by surface-specific effect maps in CP_020/CP_190/CP_220 and by the Water branch of PlayManualGroundEffect. Native offset +0x08. Export rows: Soil, Concrete, Grass, Gravel, Iron, Water, Tile, Wood.

Id_Effect_Footstep.technical: TArray<FName> (row +0x10) indexed by GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex(EGameFootstepActionType) = enum value - 1: Run->0, Dash->1, None->-1, Invalid(255)->254. The base controller and shikigami controller reject Index < 0 and out-of-range indices; the sequencer uses IsValidIndex. The resulting ID is resolved against EffectDataTables and spawned at the notify transform with the owner’s GetMapGroundEffectScale(). Sequencer footstep tracks use Section.FootstepActionType with the same index; per-character overrides can remap the resolved FName. All 8 exported rows have 2 entries.

Id_SoundEffect_Footstep.simple: Footstep sound IDs by character footstep type.
Id_SoundEffect_Footstep.technical: TArray<FName> (row +0x20) indexed by GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex(Actor->GetFootstepType()) (EGameFootstepType ShoesMan=1 .. Totality=6 -> indices 0..5); None->-1, Invalid(255)->254 and other out-of-range values are ignored by the runtime bounds checks. Each ID is resolved to a SoundEffect row and played as 3D SE at the foot socket/location. Sequencer ground-SE and ground-effect-and-SE evaluates use the same indexing with IsValidIndex. All 8 exported rows have 6 entries.

Id_Effect_DashBegin.simple: Effect played when a dash starts on this surface.
Id_Effect_DashBegin.technical: FName effect ID (row +0x30). CN_060/CN_081/CN_140 controllers and shared GameCharacterAction_Dash resolve it through EffectDataTables, spawn it with the owner’s location and root rotation (transform scale 1), then set actor scale to GetMapGroundEffectScale(). NAME_None resolves to no effect. Exported examples: FX_CP_000_01112 (Soil/non-Water) and FX_CP_000_01122 (Water).

Id_SoundEffect_DashBegin.simple: Sound played when a dash starts on this surface.
Id_SoundEffect_DashBegin.technical: FName sound ID (row +0x38) resolved through the action helper to a SoundEffect row and played as 3D SE at the owner’s location. Used by the shared dash action, CN_060/CN_081/CN_140, CP_180 and shikigami dash. Exported values: SE_CP_000_02001 for Soil/non-Water and SE_CP_000_02101 for Water.

Id_SoundEffect_DashEnd.simple: Sound played when a dash ends on this surface.
Id_SoundEffect_DashEnd.technical: FName sound ID (row +0x40). The shared dash action uses it directly and PlaySoundEffect resolves it to a SoundEffect row for 3D playback at the owner’s location. CP_180’s override does not use the row ID directly: it starts from fixed fallback SE_CP_180_01021 and remaps SE_CP_000_02002 -> SE_CP_180_01021 and SE_CP_000_02102 -> SE_CP_180_01022; the selected FName is then resolved by PlaySoundEffect. Exported values: SE_CP_000_02002 (Soil/non-Water), SE_CP_000_02102 (Water).

Id_Effect_JumpBegin.simple: Effect played when jumping off this surface.
Id_Effect_JumpBegin.technical: FName effect ID returned by UGameCharacterActionController::GetJumpEffectName (vslot 128, retail 0x141182440, row +0x48) and read by PlayJumpEffect; the effect is spawned with identity rotation at the owner's location scaled by GetMapGroundEffectScale() and then Initialize'd. Shikigami read the same field in Shikigami_PlayGroundEffectAndSound.

Id_SoundEffect_JumpBegin.simple: Sound played when jumping off this surface.
Id_SoundEffect_JumpBegin.technical: FName; PlayJumpEffect resolves it to a SoundEffect row (bCheckNone=true) and plays its CueSheetName/CueName as 3D SE at the owner's location with game default parameters. Shikigami read it alongside Id_Effect_JumpBegin. Row offset +0x50. Exported Soil value: SE_CP_000_03001.

Id_Effect_Landing.simple: Effect played on landing on this surface.
Id_Effect_Landing.technical: FName effect ID returned by GetLandingEffectName (vslot 129, retail 0x141182570, row +0x58). PlayLandingEffect spawns it at the owner's location with ground-effect scale; CP_070 and the shared dash/landing code and shikigami also read it directly. Exported Soil value: FX_CP_000_02012.

Id_SoundEffect_Landing.simple: Sound played on landing on this surface.
Id_SoundEffect_Landing.technical: FName; PlayLandingEffect and CP_070 resolve it to a SoundEffect row and play 3D SE at the owner/landing location. Row offset +0x60. Exported Soil value: SE_CP_000_03002.

Id_Effect_Ground.simple: Ground-contact effect IDs by ground-effect type.
Id_Effect_Ground.technical: TArray<FName> (row +0x68) indexed by GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex(EGameGroundEffectType) (Normal=0, Brake=1, Upper=2, Step=3, Impact=4; None=-1; Invalid(255)->254). UGameAnimNotify_PlayGroundEffect resolves the ID to an Effect row, spawns it with the notify rotation/offset and notify scale multiplied by owner GetMapGroundEffectScale(), and can attach it to mesh socket "root". GameCharacterAction_Step computes Heavy(3)+1, i.e. TypeIndex 4 (Impact), and uses that array element without a separate bounds check. All exported rows have 5 entries.

Id_SoundEffect_Ground.simple: Ground-contact sound IDs by ground-effect type.
Id_SoundEffect_Ground.technical: TArray<FName> (row +0x78) indexed by the same EGameGroundEffectType-1 convention in UGameAnimNotify_PlayGroundEffect; each ID is resolved to a SoundEffect row and played at the notify location (optionally attaching the SE player to mesh "root"). Effect rows have their own separate Id_SoundEffect_Ground field used by AGameEffect’s ground-contact sound branch. All exported MapGround rows have 5 entries.

Id_Effect_Down.simple: Effect played when a character is knocked down on this surface.
Id_Effect_Down.technical: FName effect ID (row +0x88). FGameCharacterAction_DownBase::LandDown spawns it at the owner’s location with identity rotation. Character effect scale is GetMapGroundEffectScale() multiplied by DamageTableRow->GroundBoundEffectScale only when bFlag16B is false, a damage row exists and bBoundEnabled is false; otherwise that damage factor is 1. Shikigami LandDown uses identity rotation, owner location and GetMapGroundEffectScale() without the damage-row factor. Exported Soil value: FX_CP_000_04211.

Id_SoundEffect_Down.simple: Sound played when a character is knocked down on this surface.
Id_SoundEffect_Down.technical: FName; played as 3D SE at the owner's location in LandDown. Shikigami route it through the overridable GetDownSoundEffectId virtual before playing. Row offset +0x90. Exported Soil value: SE_CP_000_07001.

Id_Effect_Bound.simple: Effect played when a knocked-down character bounces on this surface.
Id_Effect_Bound.technical: FName effect ID (row +0x98). On the ground-bound branch it is spawned at the hit ImpactPoint with rotation from BlowBoundEffectRotation(Hit) and scale GetMapGroundEffectScale() * (damage row ? GroundBoundEffectScale : 1.0f). Exported Soil value: FX_CP_000_04611.

Id_SoundEffect_Bound.simple: Sound played when a knocked-down character bounces on this surface.
Id_SoundEffect_Bound.technical: FName; played as 3D SE at the hit ImpactPoint on the same branch as Id_Effect_Bound. Row offset +0xA0. Exported Soil value: SE_CP_000_07011.

EffectAttribute.simple: Numeric ground attribute for Niagara effects.
EffectAttribute.technical: int32 (row +0xA8) cast to float and written to each spawned effect’s Niagara user parameter "GroundAttribute" when bGroundAttributeEnabled is true; "IsGround" is set to 1 when a MapGround row was found and 0 on a miss. AGameEffect::Initialize enables the check only when EffectRow.GroundCheckTargetType is Possessor or Own; UpdateGroundAttribute early-returns without writing parameters if source interface or EffectRow is null. For Own, the trace is GetMapGroundRow(EffectLocation, EffectRow.GroundCheckDistance); otherwise the source’s current row is used. With the check disabled, GroundAttribute remains 0 while IsGround stays 1; with the check enabled but no row, both are 0. Constructor default 0. Export: Water=1, all other seven surfaces=0.

EffectColor.simple: RGB tint for effects on this surface.
EffectColor.technical: FVector (X,Y,Z). FAbramsSequencerSetEffectGroundColorEvaluate traces 100 units under the bound actor, resolves the physical surface to a MapGround row and returns FLinearColor(X,Y,Z,1); black is returned when no surface/row is found. This is a sequencer evaluate path, distinct from AGameEffectManager::ApplyMapColors which uses MapDataTable.EffectColor. Constructor default FVector::ZeroVector; all exported rows use (1,1,1).

notes: MapGroundDataTables is manager slot +0x3D0; the name is registered at GameDataTableManager.cpp:339 and resolved at line 191. Character, trap, shikigami and sequencer lookups iterate that array in order and return the first matching row. Rows are selected by physical surface, not map ID; MapGroundDataTable has the same eight exported surface rows, while MapDataTable supplies per-map colors/assets.

Every exported array slot is populated and uniform: footstep effects 2, footstep sounds 6, ground effects 5, ground sounds 5. No exported slot is empty or NAME_None; Water and some other rows reuse IDs across slots rather than leaving holes.

Sound fields name SoundEffectDataTable rows (resolved by Status_FindSoundEffectRow / PlaySoundEffect, with bCheckNone=true); effect fields name EffectDataTable rows (resolved by Status_FindEffectRow). These joins happen at play time, not preload time; a missing row yields no effect/sound (PlaySoundEffect returns -1).

GetMapGroundRow traces from Location + Up*Distance to Location + Down*Distance over CN_050_GroundObjectTypes (retail .data 0x14638C870). AtLocation and shikigami use Distance=50; character/controller call sites pass 50/100/200/500 and EffectRow.GroundCheckDistance passes an Effect-table distance. AGameSequencerManager::FindMapGroundRow instead traces downward by section GroundTraceLength (defaults 10 for effect+SE, 120 for SE-only) and subtracts Offset; the EffectColor evaluate uses its own fixed 100-unit downward trace.

All 18 exported fields have at least one substantive reconstructed consumer. Id also drives surface-specific maps in CP_020/CP_190/CP_220 and a Water branch in PlayManualGroundEffect. Per-character overrides (CP_081 jump/landing/footstep effect remaps, CN_110 dash footstep remap, CP_180 dash-end SE remap, CN_231 down-sound override, shikigami virtuals) can change which ID is ultimately played.

usages.detail: Shared surface->MapGround row lookup used by shikigami/traps: two-ended Z line trace, UPhysicsSettings surface name, first matching row.
Character surface lookup over MapGroundDataTables with caller-supplied Distance; AtLocation/current-row wrappers use 50.
Sequencer surface lookup uses section-configured GroundTraceLength and an Offset rather than the fixed 100-unit trace used by EffectColor.
Virtual getters for jump/landing/footstep effect IDs (slots 128/129/131) followed by effect spawning and SE playback.
Footstep animation notify resolves the ground under the chosen foot socket, plays the footstep effect and type-indexed footstep SE.
Ground-effect notify type-indexes Id_Effect_Ground and Id_SoundEffect_Ground, spawns/attaches effects and SE players.
Dash start/end reads the dash effect/sound IDs and spawns/plays them with owner location, rotation and ground-effect scale.
Down and bound branches read Id_Effect_Down/Sound_Down and Id_Effect_Bound/Sound_Bound with damage-row bound scaling.
Effect ground-attribute setup writes EffectAttribute and IsGround into every Niagara component and has distinct disabled/no-row outcomes.
Sequencer evaluate reads EffectColor from the surface row under the bound actor.
Sequencer ground-effect track reads type-indexed footstep effect/sound IDs from the surface row.
Direct Id consumer: maps the surface row ID to a character-specific spawn effect.
Direct Id consumer: maps surface to blood-pool effect variant (and Water sound branch) for generated drops.
Direct Id consumer: maps surface to cursed-energy ground effect variant.
Direct Id consumer: selects notify-provided Water effect/sound pair when the row ID is Water.
